expressions.title: The Salaries and Allowances of Ministers Act, 1949
expressions.title_basis: p1 block 2009978 prints 'ACT No. XV OF 1949 An Act to provide for the salaries and allowances of Ministers' (the catalogue's number XIV is that of the preceding Act on the page); s.1 names it the Salaries and Allowances of Ministers Act, 1949; it runs to s.4 and the signature 'M. B. AHMAD, Secretary' (block 2009993). Blocks 2009967-2009977 (the running head and ACT No. XIV OF 1949, the Control of Shipping (Amendment) Act, 1949) are the law of document 5188, released there from the same Gazette page -- set aside as apparatus here so the law is not duplicated (owner policy q1 'split').
